title: A dataset of mentorship in science with semantic and demographic estimations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a deep learning name-to-ethnicity prediction model for representation bias and performance disparities by testing it on a curated dataset of African-American scientists (Black In Neuro) and comparing it with U.S. Census surname data.

Developing and validating a demographic estimation model that infers gender from researchers' first names (including an 'unknown' category to capture potentially non-binary individuals) to facilitate future evaluation of gender disparities in scientific mentorship.
